remarks: Welcome to your new storybook charmer! Tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this delightful Cape-style home offers a perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience. With three spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms, it's an ideal choice for first-time buyers or those looking to downsize. Step inside to discover a warm and inviting living room, where a cozy fireplace beckons you to unwind and enjoy quiet evenings at home.  The main floor features a comfortable bedroom and a full bathroom, offering easy accessibility and convenience. Upstairs, you'll find two large bedrooms, providing ample space and privacy.  The beautifully landscaped, flat yard is an outdoor paradise, complete with a sparkling in-ground pool. Whether you're hosting summer pool parties or simply enjoying a tranquil afternoon in your private oasis, this backyard is ready for you to create unforgettable memories. Located a short distance to the train station, this home offers exceptional convenience for commuters and travelers. Plus, the town's extensive amenities are just a stone's throw away, making it easy to enjoy local parks, shopping, and dining. This Cape-style gem is brimming with potential and ready for your personal touch. Don't miss the chance to make this charming home yours
